name: Sun Pharma

snapshot.about: Sun Pharma is an Indian pharmaceutical company manufacturing innovative and generic medicines globally.

narrative: Management promised high single-digit top-line growth for FY27, matching Q1 FY27 revenue growth of 10.1% YoY to ₹15,183.6 crore. However, Q1 FY27 R&D spending at 5.4% of sales lagged the target range of 6% to 7%.

promises.statement: The acquisition of Organon is expected to close in 6 to 9 months.

said.quote: we expect this deal to close in about six to nine month time

actual_source.quote: We expect the acquisition to be completed in Q4 FY27

promises.note: Management consistently targets transaction closure in Q4 FY27.

promises.statement: R&D spend is expected to be 6% to 7% of sales in FY27.

said.quote: We expect our FY27 R&D spend to be 6% to 7% of the sales for the next year

actual_source.quote: Consolidated investments towards R&D for Q1 FY27 stands at INR8,264 million or 5.4% of sales

promises.note: Q1 FY27 R&D spend was 5.4% of sales, slightly below target range.

promises.statement: Effective tax rate is expected to be in the range of 25% for next year.

said.quote: We expect the effective tax rate to be in the range of 25%

actual_source.quote: Going forward, and until Organon closing, we expect the tax rate to be in a similar range as in Q1

promises.note: Reconfirmed expected tax rate range in Q1 FY27 call.

promises.statement: Company expects Organon acquisition to complete in Q4 FY27.

said.quote: We expect the acquisition to be completed in Q4 FY27

actual_source.quote: We expect the acquisition to be completed in Q4 of financial year '27

promises.note: Reiterated Q4 FY27 completion timeline during Q1 FY27 call.

promises.statement: Management expects cost synergies of around $350 million to materialize over the next two to four years.

said.quote: There are also significant potential synergies that could come out, which we have highlighted could be in the range of about $350 million which could be materialized in the next two to four years

promises.statement: Post-acquisition combined company net debt to EBITDA is expected to be 2.3x.

said.quote: We also see that Sun from a net cash positive position post this acquisition will get into a net debt by EBITDA of 2.3x

promises.statement: Management expects the acquisition to be EPS accretive from the first 12 months post-closing.

said.quote: we believe this will be EPS accretive from the beginning

promises.statement: Company expects high single-digit top line growth in FY27.

said.quote: On the guidance, we expect high single-digit consolidated top line growth for FY27 based on our current understanding of the regulatory and macro environment

promises.statement: Effective tax rate expected in a similar range as Q1 FY27 until Organon closing.

said.quote: Going forward, and until Organon closing, we expect the tax rate to be in a similar range as in Q1

signals.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹52,570 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹43,986 crore.

cash.read: Profits convert strongly into cash. Cumulative operating cash flow of ₹52,570 crore comfortably exceeded total reported net profit of ₹43,986 crore over the FY22–FY26 period.

bull.point: Strong cash generation fully backs earnings, with operating cash flow exceeding cumulative net profit over the past five financial years.

evidence.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹52,570 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹43,986 crore.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bull.point: India formulation sales demonstrated robust growth, expanding 16% year-on-year in the first quarter of FY27 to ₹54,749 million.

evidence.quote: Sales of India formulations were INR54,749 million for the quarter, recording a growth of 16%
Sales of India formulations were INR54,749 million for the quarter, recording a growth of 16%

bull.point: Innovative medicine sales grew 12.8% year-on-year to $351 million in the first quarter of FY27.

evidence.quote: In Q1 FY27, our innovative medicine sales were up 12.8% to reach USD351 million
In Q1 FY27, our innovative medicine sales were up 12.8% to reach USD351 million

bear.point: The company engages in massive material related-party transactions, including transactions exceeding ₹294,921 million with a single subsidiary.

evidence.quote: The aggregate amount of transactions for FY26 was ₹ 294,921.1 Million

bear.point: US business sales declined by 9.7% year-on-year in Q1 FY27 to USD 427 million, indicating headwinds in key overseas markets.

evidence.quote: Overall, the U.S. business reported sales of USD427 million for the quarter, declining by 9.7%

bear.point: The pending Organon acquisition will shift the company from a net cash position to a net debt to EBITDA ratio of 2.3x.

evidence.quote: We also see that Sun from a net cash positive position post this acquisition will get into a net debt by EBITDA of 2.3x
